title: textspot6: A9 estimates of runtime/vocr_textspot6.c (VTSP version 4, 4 tags) and of the same shapes' version-2/3 blobs (2026-10-26)
note: estimates: qemu-arm instruction counts of the Vita compiler's code priced by vita/a9_cycles.py's Cortex-A9 model, not a console measurement; est. ms @333 = high bound x 1.0007 / 333 MHz, est. ms @444 = that x 333/444; nothing ran on a console. Arena, code and stack bytes are exact.
method: textspot_a9.py measure --out DIR [--shapes s4_c8,...] [--scales h2,f1] [--sizes 960x544,480x272]                          [--formats grey] [--nodark] [--cflags "-O2"] [--seed 1] [--jobs 5] [--vitasdk DIR]                          [--arm-cc GCC] [--qemu DIR]   textspot_a9.py report DIR [--json eval/textspot_a9_YYYYMMDD.json] [--also DIR2 --also-label TEXT ...]

tools.vita_cc: arm-vita-eabi-gcc (GNU Tools for ARM Embedded Processors) 15.2.0

probes.how: T_FULL_PROBE's candidates (tags 4, -O2, the default call), 960x544 only, measured once to choose T_FULL_ADDED

forced.how: regions of the given sizes (textspot's pinned procedural frame of that size) read with VOCR_TEXTSPOT6_SCALE<force> as the crop decodes read a unit's region (Rubi: the player's region of a 960 x 544 frame, halved); every time a host estimate

code_size.how: eval/textspot2_a9.py codesize's: the .text of the spotter's own sections kept by a --gc-sections link (-Wl,-Map) of a caller of load, both arena functions, find and find_rows; vita/textgate_size.py's flags and map parser; vocr_lines*.c and libgcc listed apart, not counted; each build without and with -DVOCR_TEXTSPOT6_NO_MS

stack.how: eval/textspot3_a9r.py stack's: gcc -fcallgraph-info=su over vocr_textspot6.c, vocr_lines.c and vocr_lines_rows.c; every frame static; the heaviest path (eval/textspot3_a9r.peaks, psp/stack.py's parser); calls outside them listed, their frames not counted
